description: This file is a URL configuration module for a Django project. It defines URL patterns, schema views for API documentation (Swagger, ReDoc), and a function to generate full request URLs including handling proxy headers.

methods.name: get_full_url
methods.description: Constructs the full URL from a Django request object, considering the scheme, host, and forwarded port headers.

methods.name: dynamic_schema_view
methods.description: Dynamically generates the API schema view with a full URL including schema information, intended to serve API docs.
